post.description:
Output is an MP4 video with an audio track generated together with the video (dialogue written in the prompt is spoken). Audio cannot be turned off.

## Create Task

Use this endpoint to create a new text-to-video generation task.

<Card title="Get Task Details" icon="lucide-search" href="/market/common/get-task-detail">
  After submission, use the unified query endpoint to check task progress and retrieve results
</Card>

::: tip[]
For production use, we recommend providing the `callBackUrl` parameter so your service can receive completion notifications instead of polling for task status.
:::

## File Upload

::: tip[]
Need to upload files before calling this endpoint? See [File Upload API Quickstart](/file-upload-api/quickstart).
:::

model.description: The model name used for generation. This endpoint must use `grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview`.

callBackUrl.description: Optional callback URL for task completion notifications. If provided, the system will send a POST request to this URL when the task completes.

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task.

prompt.description: Prompt for video generation. Maximum length: 4096 characters.  Use `@imageN` in the prompt to reference an image from `image_urls`, where N is the 1-based index of the image. For example, `@image1` refers to the first image in the array.

image_urls.description: Upload image files to be used as API input. Supported file types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/jpg. Maximum file size: 20MB. Supports multi-file upload, up to 1 file.Only one is supported when the resolution is 1080p.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Range: [1, 15]. Default: 8. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 15. Step: 1.

first_frame_url.description: First-frame image. Can be passed together with image_urls, or sent on its own.

loop_url.description: Loop image used as both the start and end of the video. Cannot be sent together with a different first-frame or last-frame image.

keyframes.description: Mid-video keyframes, up to 4. Each item must include url and timestamp_s (in seconds). Each timestamp must be greater than 0 and less than duration, and any two keyframes must be at least 1/3 second apart.

enable_audio.description: Whether to generate audio. Defaults to true.

nsfw_checker.description: Defaults to false. You can set it to false based on your needs. If set to false, our content filtering will be disabled, and all results will be returned directly by the model itself.

input.prompt: Describe the scene you want to generate.

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

msg.description: Response message, error description when failed

taskId.description: Task ID, can be used with Get Task Details endpoint to query task status

recordId.description: Record ID, can be used to get the record details

post.description: The system sends this callback when the `grok-imagine-video-1-5-preview` task succeeds or fails.

code.description: Unified callback code: 200 for success, 501 for failure.

model.description: The model used for the task.

param.description: JSON string containing the submitted task parameters.

resultJson.description: JSON string containing resultUrls, firstFrameUrl, lastFrameUrl, or resultObject when successful. Present only when state is success.

failCode.description: Failure code, a numeric string such as "400" or "500". Present only when state is fail.

failMsg.description: Failure reason. Present only when state is fail.

costTime.description: Processing time in seconds. Present on both success and failure callbacks.

updateTime.description: Use completeTime as the completion time; updateTime may equal createTime.

creditsConsumed.description: Credits consumed by the task; 0 for failed tasks.
